senses.gloss: (cmp. Arab. ḫatab, a. חטף) to fall in love, to woo.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:26">Koh. R. to VII, 26</cite> <he>היתה חוֹטֶבֶת באדם וכ׳</he> she would propose to a man in the street (some ed. <he>חוֹטֶפֶת</he>). [<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>חטבו ממנה</he>, v. <cite ref="H00639"><he>חָטַף</he></cite>.]—V. <cite ref="H00624"><he>חֲטִיבָה</he></cite>.
